note: The stale-tree guard (register decision 225). The script mutants blind scripts/check-configure-current.py one way each and are judged by its self-test; the module mutants break the configure-time refusal or its record and are judged by configure_guard, which configures a scratch project that edits itself, and by configure_current on this tree; the CMake mutants unhook the guard from this project and are judged by configure_current against the tree they regenerate. Since M1-109 (register decision 392) a Python mutant names no build target, and the harness builds nothing for it; until then every mutant named orbsim_shaders as a no-op, which made every shader an input of this file. A CMake mutant names build.ninja instead, which re-runs CMake when a CMake file changed and builds nothing else.
